newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended mixed after U.S. Treasury bonds fell following release of U.S. manufacturing data.
The Swiss June Confederate bond futures contract ended the day off highs after the U.S. data.
Activity was largely confined to professionals. Some of these firms may be long Swiss cash bonds, one trader said.
Others denied that the market was especially long. In any case the market seemed characterised largely by uncertainty, traders said.

On Wednesday morning the SNB added liquidity at 1-5/8 percent, the same level set in other recent transations. The latest addition, which traders said will mature on May 12, was seen as an affirmation that at very least, the SNB was continuing to pursue its policy of providing enough liquidity to keep short-term rates below 2.00 percent.
One trader also expected to see more volatility in the market, but said there may be a chance for Swiss bonds to decouple a bit from trends in other markets.
Conf futures CONFc1 down two at 118.15.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up 14 at 111.00
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down six at 98.03.
